coreClaim: Manual Illustrator paintbrush retries preserve the manual-request signal so the agent can use conversation context and repair a declined prompt before image generation.

inScope: Conversation and roleplay manual Illustrator retries
Declined-prompt repair before the selected-message fallback
outOfScope: Automatic Illustrator cadence and significance decisions
Image provider transport and model behavior
riskFlags: conversation and roleplay shared retry path

claimBoundary.coreClaim: Manual Illustrator paintbrush retries preserve the manual-request signal from the UI retry input through agent prompt construction and declined-response repair.
legacyPathsOrFormats: Manual selected-message fallback after repeated declined or unusable agent responses
outOfScopeClaims: This change does not increase the global Illustrator context window.
This change does not alter automatic Illustrator cadence or image-provider behavior.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: The manual paintbrush option reached fallback handling but was dropped before createGenerationAgentRuntime, so the runtime could not add manual instructions or repair a declined response.
contractLaneGate.producer: The conversation and roleplay paintbrush action sets RetryAgentsInput.options.illustratorManualRequest to true.
contractLaneGate.consumer: buildAgentContext and the Illustrator executor consume GenerationAgentRuntimeInput.illustratorManualRequest to add prompt instructions and enable repair.
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: A true manual paintbrush option must remain true through the retry orchestrator into the agent runtime.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: runGenerationAgentsForTarget now passes the option directly into createGenerationAgentRuntime; the public retry test observes the manual prompt block and repair call.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: start-generation.ts owns retry orchestration and agent-runner.ts owns agent runtime context construction.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not copy conversation text into the UI or expand the context-blind image fallback; preserve the existing engine runtime contract.
regressionProof: The focused public-seam test fails before the fix with one LLM request and passes after the fix with the initial contextual request plus a repair request.
The existing fallback test still passes when both model responses remain unusable.

positiveRows.claim: A declined manual Illustrator response is repaired with the selected conversation context.
positiveRows.evidence: The focused retryGenerationAgents test observes two LLM requests, the manual prompt block, prior user context, the selected assistant response, and the repaired prompt delivered to image generation.

contradictionRows.claim: Repeated unusable Illustrator responses must not remove the existing last-resort fallback.
contradictionRows.evidence: The existing selected-message fallback test remains green after the flag handoff.

contradictionRows.claim: Automatic Illustrator runs must not be converted into manual requests.
contradictionRows.evidence: The new handoff is strictly true only when input.options.illustratorManualRequest is true; omitted and false values remain false.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: The default selected-message fallback remains available after repair cannot obtain a usable prompt.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: The full 25-test retry-agent suite includes and passes the existing fallback behavior.

untestedRows: A post-merge live Pi image-quality rerun is not part of non-destructive deployment proof.

ownedFacts.description: The reported live Pi run persisted the deterministic fallback rather than a model-authored Illustrator prompt.
ownedFacts.evidence: The agent run reported zero tokens, zero duration, and the manual fallback reason.

ownedFacts.description: The missing handoff was between retry orchestration and the already-existing manual Illustrator runtime behavior.
ownedFacts.evidence: Derived from start-generation.ts, agent-runner.ts, and agent-executor.ts before the change.

steps: Inspect the latest live Pi Illustrator agent run for the reported conversation.
Confirm the persisted result used the zero-token manual selected-message fallback.
Exercise retryGenerationAgents with illustratorManualRequest enabled and an initial shouldGenerate=false result.
beforeEvidence: The live Pi persisted a successful Illustrator result with zero tokens, zero duration, and reason 'Manual paintbrush fallback from the selected message.'
The focused test made one LLM request instead of the expected initial request plus manual repair request.
